note: Roster is DATA. Adding an agent is an edit HERE, never in the page markup. An agent with no sprite gets a neutral placeholder at a standard station - degraded, not broken.
_art: There are NO image assets on this page. The floor is drawn procedurally so the six rooms form ONE building with shared walls, a paved aisle and real doors. Pre-rendered per-room dioramas cannot do that: each carries its own ground plane, lighting and perspective, so they never compose into a floor.

The Higgsfield concept sheets are REFERENCE for appearance and motion intent, not runtime atlases. DESIGN.md is explicit - they are not registered transparent atlases and must not be cropped and shipped as supposedly smooth animation. They live outside the served page.

`sprite` names the character draw function in world.js. `station` selects the furniture cluster. color/floor/wall/trim are that room's palette - rooms differ in hue but share one lighting model, which is what makes them read as one floor.
